147:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The battles over the $$スフィア$$s... I'm sure they will produce many $$Ｚチップ$$.」

147:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And when enough of them have been gathered... that will surely be the time of the real battle between us, $n, and them...」

147:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's been a while, Bushi... I mean, Mr. $$グラハム$$.」

147:t_10:15.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I'll be relying on you again, $$ＡＧ$$.」

147:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So Bushi... I mean, Mr. $$グラハム$$ has joined up with $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ in North America as well.」

147:t_10:17.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Sorry, but a jest that mild won't rattle me now.」

147:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「An answer found at the end of your doubts... I pray you never lose sight of it again.」

147:t_10:19.en:
$$グラハム$$
「So you do know about my past.」

147:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, you know... Information is a dimensional merchant's lifeline.」

147:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you'd rather I not touch on it, after all?」

147:t_10:22.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Even my past shames were needed to shape who I am now. I have no intention of denying them.」

147:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I'll spare no reserve and interview you about how you felt back then.」

147:t_10:24.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「What's up, $$ＡＧ$$? You that eager to hear stories from the old days?」

147:t_10:26.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Wrong. That's not what I'm called.」

147:t_10:28.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「No, no. These days it's Happy $$コーラサワー$$, isn't it? Get your info updated properly.」

147:t_10:30.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「All right, then, updates included, let's start reminiscing about me and Colonel $$マネキン$$... I mean, Brigadier General $$マネキン$$.」

147:t_10:31.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「First up, Chapter One, Episode One: the shocking slap at our first meeting.」

147:t_10:33.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Information is a dimensional merchant's lifeline, isn't it? Be sure to stock up on it.」

147:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But if I do, who will mind the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ shop...」

147:t_10:35.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Leave that to me! Now then, let's give it our all again today... business, business!」

147:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$ミレイナ$$, where on earth did you come from...!?」

147:t_10:37.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Wherever there's a love story, there's $$ミレイナ・ヴァスティ$$!」

147:t_10:38.en:
$$グラハム$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are closing in on us. Keep it short, Lieutenant $$マネキン$$.」

147:t_10:39.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Right! For now, today I'll go up to Chapter Thirteen!」

147:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(This is hopeless... I don't think I could ever beat this man...)

148:t_000:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「All units are in position.」

148:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「General $$藤堂$$ is commanding the defense line. We'll stand by in Tokyo in case of an emergency.」

148:t_000:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Calm down, $n. In that state, you can't draw out the power of the $$ジェニオン$$.」

148:t_000:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I understand you're on edge after coming into contact with that Reactor.」

148:t_000:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But a person whose mind is out of balance can't move their body freely, either. Don't forget that.」

148:t_000:8.en:
$n
(You're saying the same kind of thing as Dad...)

148:t_000:10.en:
$n
「...Why did you team up with me, Captain $$アムロ$$?」

148:t_000:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...It's not something to bring up at a time like this, but part of it is that, precisely because you're on edge, I wanted to feel the $$ジェニオン$$ up close.」

148:t_000:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Maybe it's because my father was an engineer. Ever since I was a kid, I've loved tinkering with machines.」

148:t_000:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Perhaps because of that, I never had any excessive sentimentality toward machines.」

148:t_000:16.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That goes for the machine I pilot, too.」

148:t_000:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Setting aside my boyhood, as a soldier I regard even the $$ガンダム$$ as a handy tool, and I have no intention of getting attached more than necessary...」

148:t_000:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's how I used to think.」

148:t_000:20.en:
$$アムロ$$
「My view that mobile suits... that machines are tools hasn't changed.」

148:t_000:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But there's a theory that humanity evolved from earlier humans because they used tools and used fire.」

148:t_000:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe humanity today is in that kind of transitional period, too.」

148:t_000:24.en:
$n
「Are you saying tools... that machines make people evolve?」

148:t_000:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...The $$Ｚガンダム$$ and the $$ユニコーン$$, which turn people's will into power, and the $$ダブルオーライザー$$, which uses the $$ＧＮドライヴ$$ to urge an awakening into $$イノベイター$$s...」

148:t_000:26.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And your $$ジェニオン$$, too... If you look at machines like these, you start to feel that way.」

148:t_000:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's why I wanted to feel the $$ジェニオン$$ up close. Sorry, but humor my curiosity.」

148:t_000:30.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Thank you, Captain $$アムロ$$. Thanks to you, $n has calmed down again.)

148:t_000:32.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy force has broken through the first line of defense! They'll enter Tokyo shortly!」

148:t_000:33.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, prepare to intercept!」

148:t_001:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That's one hell of a number, this lot!」

148:t_001:1.en:
$$カトル$$
「Their numbers should have dropped from fighting General $$藤堂$$'s line of defense...!」

148:t_001:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「The enemy must be that serious.」

148:t_001:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then I'll just scatter every last one of them...!」

148:t_001:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We must win without fail, if only to break the stagnant atmosphere of late.」

148:t_001:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh my, everyone's so fired up, aren't they?」

148:t_001:7.en:
$$フォウ$$
「He's not like $$ギルター$$ from the other day...!」

148:t_001:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As his superior, I'll clean up the mess of my incompetent subordinate myself.」

148:t_001:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Tch... Damn that $$サルディアス$$... meddling where he's not wanted...)

148:t_001:10.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now then, introductions. I'm $$サルディアス・アクス$$... Forty-two years old this year.」

148:t_001:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I've been allowed to command this invasion of Tokyo. It may only be for today, but pray remember me.」

148:t_001:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This man commanded the operation that wounded the hearts of the people of $$新日本$$...!」

148:t_001:13.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That isn't quite correct, but it isn't entirely off the mark, either. After all, I'm the one who carried it out, yes.」

148:t_001:14.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't screw with us! Because of you, $$新日本$$ is...!」

148:t_001:15.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh my, since I talk like this I seem to get misunderstood easily, but I'm... always a serious, give-it-my-all guts man, you know.」
